text: dsh-loupe（DSH 网页插件）：选中对话中的词句，即可在浮窗查看模型解释。它接入宿主 webServer，提供流式回答、连续追问、历史搜索和上下文编辑，也能把对话保存为正式会话。适合阅读 DSH 对话时快速理解内容，并将有价值的解释留存；可调整邻近消息数量、上下文长度、推理档位和界面语言。插件使用宿主模型服务，并在本机保存上下文与问答历史。

dsh-loupe is a DSH web plugin that explains selected conversation text in a floating window. It uses the host web server and model service for streamed answers and follow-up questions. Users can search local history, edit plugin context, and save useful exchanges as regular sessions.
想在 DSH 对话里选中一个术语就马上看到解释。
有没有办法只把选中的句子发给模型解释？
我想在浮窗里继续追问刚才那段解释。
如何搜索以前划词解释过的内容？
能不能给解释模型附上一份自己维护的术语上下文？
I want to explain a selected passage without starting a full chat session.
Can I search and reopen earlier text explanations?
I want follow-up questions in a small window while reading a DSH conversation.
dsh-loupe 的功能「选词解释」：选择 DSH 对话中的文字后打开浮窗，插件将选区、所在消息和可选上下文发送给宿主模型，并以流式方式显示解释。。
dsh-loupe 的功能「多轮追问」：在解释浮窗继续提问时，客户端带上前序问答；服务端将其组成多轮模型请求并返回后续回答。。
dsh-loupe 的功能「历史检索」：用户可浏览、分页并按关键词搜索本地保存的问答记录，选中记录可恢复到浮窗继续对话。。
dsh-loupe 的功能「保存为正式会话」：浮窗中的解释对话可通过保存接口写入选定工作区，成为 DSH 正式会话。。
dsh-loupe 会将解释请求交给宿主模型服务，并在本机 DSH loupe 目录保存上下文与问答历史。

| 🌗 **跟随主题** | 深浅主题与皮肤跟随宿主；宿主没提供设计令牌时按系统深浅兜底。 |
| 🔑 **零配置** | 借用宿主的 llm 服务，不用填 API key。 |

dsh-loupe README · 插件特点：**快。** 点「解释」的时候它已经在问了 —— 浮窗打开即提交，不用再按一次发送。推理档默认 `off`，实测三次首字 **503ms / 544ms / 634ms**，整段答案 1.7–2.5 秒。它也不把 agent 的全量上下文拖进来，只发你选的那句加一本小本子；小本子放在 prompt 的固定位置，还能吃到宿主的 prompt 缓存。

**准。** 发给模型的只有三样：你选中的文字、它所在的那条消息（默认只带这一条）、以及 `context.md`（上限 2200 字）。不掺主会话那几十万 token，也就没有无关内容把解释带偏。`context.md` 里可以写术语表和你自己的用法偏好，它只装你写的东西 —— 插件不会把自己的答案写回去（1.2.0 起如此，见「自动累积为什么被移除」）。

dsh-loupe README · 插件特点：**追问是接着说的，不是重新解释。** 浮窗里的第二问起，客户端会把本浮窗已经完成的问答一起发上去（最近 6 轮），宿主组装成真正的多轮请求，并换一套「续答」框定：只答新问题、不复述、不再通篇重讲选中文字。上下文只注入你手写的内容，前几轮的答案由对话本身承载 —— 不重复注入，也就不可能被它带着复述自己。

**轻。** 宿主半端只 import `node:fs` / `node:os` / `node:path` / `node:crypto`，零第三方依赖；界面半端是手写的模块加载器模块，没有构建产物要同步。它不建会话、不写会话日志、不注册工具 —— 跑完只留下两个文件：`context.md` 和 `history.jsonl`。

**只做一件事。** 它不聊天、不总结、不改代码，就是把选中的这段解释清楚。一次问答，读完关掉；真要展开成长期讨论，点「保存」把它交回主会话。

dsh-loupe README · 本地目录（推荐）：```bash
git clone https://github.com/Rice00/dsh-loupe.git
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add link:/abs/path/to/dsh-loupe
```

补丁会往 profile 里插一行（`loupe`）。**然后重启这个 profile** —— 宿主插件模块在进程内缓存，运行中的 harness 读不到新行。只改界面的话刷新浏览器就够了。

`link:` 是活链接，改源码立刻生效；代价是装完之后不能挪动这个目录。想连文件一起复制走用 `file:`，以后每次改都要重装。

text:
dsh-loupe README · 常见问题：**会污染我的主会话吗？**
不会。只发一次模型请求，不建会话、不写会话日志、不注册工具。

**要填 API key 吗？**
不用。走宿主已有的 `llm` 服务，默认跟随 `agent-default-model`。

**它和「侧边对话」有什么不同？**
侧边对话会把主会话的整个历史 fork 一份，几十万 token；这个插件只带上你选的那句话和一本小本子。

**为什么默认 `off` 推理档？**
解释单段文字用不上高推理。同一个问题实测 off 首字 **544ms**，low **2806ms**。嫌答得浅就在参数页调 `low`。

**关掉浮窗，内容还在吗？**
在。全在 `history.jsonl` 里，设置页「历史」点一条就能接着问。

**浮窗拖不动？**
设置页「诊断」里有拖动事件计数 —— 拖一下看数字涨不涨，就知道事件有没有传到宿主。

**玻璃质感没效果？**
需要浏览器支持 `color-mix`。不支持时自动退回实底，其余功能照常。

dsh-loupe README · 常见问题：**界面能换英文吗？**
能。设置页「参数」里的「界面语言」选 `en`，界面与提示词立刻变英文；`auto` 取宿主设置里的语言偏好，没有则用浏览器语言（宿主页面上的 `lang` 是模板固定值，不参与判断）。主题不用选，它自己跟随宿主。

dsh-loupe README · 自动累积为什么被移除：1.0.x 里，每解释一次就把「选区 → 答案前 160 字」追加进 `context.md` 的受控区块，再随每轮请求注入 system。1.2.0 起这块逻辑整体删掉了，原因有四条：

- **它是历史数据的劣质副本。** `history.jsonl` 已经存了完整的问答原文；累积出来的只有截断到 160 字的摘要，很多从句子中间切断，却要占 prompt 预算。
- **它把模型自己的措辞喂回去。** 追问时模型读到自己上一轮的答案，就会接着复述 —— 这是「追问重复上一答」的主要来源之一。
- **它挤掉了用户自己写的东西。** 实测一份长期使用的 `context.md`：自动累积占 99.9%，60 条顶到上限，而 2200 字注入预算只装得下最新 14 条；手写术语表一条也进不去。
- **它在破坏自己的前提。** 每答完就改文档，system 的稳定前缀每轮都变，宿主的 prompt 缓存无从命中。

升级不会丢东西：迁移先备份 `context.md.bak-<时间戳>`，再只剥带标记的那一段，手写内容原样保留。
section: 自动累积为什么被移除

| 参数 | 默认 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|
| 推理档 | `off` | `off` / `low` / `high` / `max`。解释单段文字用不上高推理。 |
| 邻域条数 | `0` | `0` / `1` / `2` / `4`。选区前后各带几条对话进 prompt。0 = 只带所在那条消息。 |

| 界面语言 | `auto` | `auto` / `zh` / `en`。`auto` 取宿主设置里的语言偏好（`locale.preference`），没有则用浏览器语言；宿主页面上的 `lang` 属性是模板固定值，不参与判断。只翻译界面与提示词。 |

dsh-loupe README · 数据与接口：<details>
<summary>给要改代码或接管线的人</summary>

数据落在 `~/.dsh/loupe/`（有 `DSH_HOME` 就跟着它）：

```
context.md     插件上下文（只有你手写的内容）
history.jsonl  全部问答记录（只追加，不重写；超过 8MB 时只读尾部）
debug.log      选词诊断日志（每次选词一行 JSON；超过 512 KB 只留最后 200 行）
```

1.2.0 起不再写「自动累积」区块。升级时插件会把旧文件里的那块剥掉、原样备份成 `context.md.bak-<时间戳>`，迁移结果同时出现在 `/probe` 的 `contextMigration` 与设置页「上下文」页顶部。

`debug.log` 记的是「这一次框选，宿主实际拿到了什么」—— 排查「词明明在对话里，解释却说没出现」这类问题时用它，比 `history.jsonl` 更直接：

dsh-loupe README · 数据与接口：```json
{"at":1792424435881,"kind":"assistant-step","turn":"51","node":"14:assistant-step51:3",
 "len":2093,"sent":1915,"win":[193,2093],"anchor":921,
 "selAt":[196,300,460],"winAt":[18,122,282],"head80":"…（前面省略 193 字）…"}
```

| 字段 | 含义 |
|---|---|
| `kind` / `turn` / `node` | 取中的那一条消息的节点类型、所属轮次、节点键 |
| `len` / `sent` | 那条消息的总字数 / 实际送进 prompt 的字数（超出 1900 时按选区开窗） |
| `win` | 窗口在原消息里的起止下标 |
| `selAt` / `winAt` | 选区在原消息里 / 在送出的窗口里的位置；`winAt` 为空说明没包住 |
| `head80` | 送出窗口的前 80 字（用来一眼确认取到的是哪一段） |

dsh-loupe README · 数据与接口：默认一直记录，纯本地文件。不想记就在浏览器控制台执行 `localStorage.setItem('loupe-debug','0')` 后刷新；想恢复改成 `'1'` 再刷新。

宿主半端提供的路由：

```
GET  /plugins/dsh-loupe/probe     诊断：宿主能力 / 模型解析 / context 可写性 / 拖动事件 / 工作区探测
POST /plugins/dsh-loupe/explain   解释调用（SSE：meta / thinking / reasoning / first / delta / done / error）
GET  /plugins/dsh-loupe/history   历史（最新在前；?limit= &offset= &q= 搜索与分页）
GET  /plugins/dsh-loupe/context   读上下文

dsh-loupe README · 数据与接口：`/explain` 的请求体：`selection` / `question` / `messageText` / `neighborCount` / `reasoningEffort` / `contextChars`；追问时多带一个 `history: [{ question, answer }]`（客户端取本浮窗最近 6 轮，服务端再裁到 8 轮 / 每答 4000 字 / 总 16000 字）。带 `history` 时服务端把消息组装成 `user → assistant → user …` 的多轮序列，选区只出现在第一条。注入的 `context.md` 一律先剥掉旧版遗留的自动累积区块（1.2.0 已不再写入；正常迁移过的机器上它本来就不存在）。

代码结构：

dsh-loupe README · 数据与接口：```
lib/index.js       宿主半端 —— 路由 / prompt 组装 / 流式解析 / 落盘（只 import Node 内置模块）
lib/client.js      界面半端 —— 划词 / 浮标 / 浮窗 / 四个页签（手写模块，无构建步骤）
cordis.patch.yml   补丁
docs/              实施与修复记录，含「保存」链路的复盘

宿主半端不热重载（改 `lib/index.js` 要重启 profile），界面半端刷新页面即可。

</details>

dsh-loupe README · Features：| | |
|---|---|
| 🖱️ **Select and it pops** | Select any text in a message body and two entries, "Explain / Settings", appear below the selection. |
| 🪟 **Answers in a window** | Not a sidebar. Single instance, multi-turn follow-ups (from the second question on, each turn carries this window's earlier turns), streaming markdown, draggable, position remembered. |
| 🔌 **No session created** | One model request only: no session log, no tool registration, the left-hand list never gets dirty. |
| 📚 **Brings its own context** | Uses the plugin's own `context.md` instead of dragging in the agent's full context — faster and cheaper. |
| 🧾 **Context is only yours** | `context.md` injects what you wrote; the plugin never writes its own answers back. |
| 🗂️ **Everything archived** | Every exchange goes into history, searchable by keyword and paged; click one and it is restored into the window for more questions. |
| 📌 **Pinnable as a session** | An explanation worth keeping: pick a target workspace, save it, and it becomes a real session in the left-hand list, auto-named "Selection · <word>". |

dsh-loupe README · Plugin traits：**Fast.** By the time you click "Explain" it is already asking — the window submits on open, so there is no second send to press. The reasoning level defaults to `off`, and three measured runs gave a first token at **503ms / 544ms / 634ms**, with a full answer in 1.7–2.5 seconds. It also does not drag the agent's full context in: it sends only the sentence you selected plus a small notebook, and the notebook sits at a fixed spot in the prompt so it still hits the host's prompt cache.

dsh-loupe README · Plugin traits：**Precise.** Three things go to the model: the text you selected, the message it sits in (only that one by default), and `context.md` (capped at 2200 characters). None of the main conversation's hundreds of thousands of tokens come along, so nothing unrelated can pull the explanation off course. `context.md` is where a glossary and your own usage preferences go, and it holds only what you wrote — the plugin never writes its own answers back (since 1.2.0; see "Why auto-accumulation was removed").

dsh-loupe README · Plugin traits：**Follow-ups continue the thread instead of re-explaining.** From the second question on, the client sends this window's finished exchanges along (the last 6 turns); the host assembles a real multi-turn request and switches to a follow-up framing: answer only the new question, do not restate it, do not re-explain the whole passage. The context carries only what you wrote, and earlier answers travel in the conversation itself — so there is no digest of its own words for the model to copy.

dsh-loupe README · Plugin traits：**Light.** The host half imports only `node:fs` / `node:os` / `node:path` / `node:crypto` — zero third-party dependencies; the UI half is a hand-written module-loader module with no build output to keep in sync. It creates no session, writes no session log and registers no tool — running it leaves two files behind: `context.md` and `history.jsonl`.

dsh-loupe README · Plugin traits：**One job only.** It does not chat, summarise or edit code; it explains the selected passage. One exchange, read it, close it — when you really want a long discussion, click "Save" and hand it back to the main conversation.

The patch inserts one row (`loupe`) into the profile. **Then restart that profile** — host plugin modules are cached in-process, so a running harness will not read the new row. UI-only changes just need a browser refresh.

text:
dsh-loupe README · FAQ：**Will it pollute my main conversation?**
No. One model request only: no session, no session log, no tool registration.

**Do I need an API key?**
No. It goes through the host's existing `llm` service and follows `agent-default-model` by default.

**How is it different from a side conversation?**
A side conversation forks the entire history of the main conversation, hundreds of thousands of tokens; this plugin takes only the sentence you selected and a small notebook.

dsh-loupe README · FAQ：**Why is the reasoning level `off` by default?**
Explaining one passage does not need high reasoning. On the same question the first token took **544ms** at `off` and **2806ms** at `low`. If the answer feels shallow, raise it to `low` in Settings.

**If I close the window, is the content still there?**
Yes. It is all in `history.jsonl`, and clicking an entry under Settings → "History" restores it so you can keep asking.

dsh-loupe README · FAQ：**The window will not drag?**
The "Diagnostics" tab in Settings carries drag-event counters — drag once and see whether the numbers move, and you know whether the events reach the host half.

**The glass look does nothing?**
It needs browser support for `color-mix`. Without it the window falls back to a solid background and everything else keeps working.

dsh-loupe README · FAQ：**Can I switch the interface to English?**
Yes — pick `en` under "Language" in Settings and the interface and the prompt switch immediately. `auto` uses the host's language preference, falling back to the browser language (the host page's `lang` attribute is a static template value). The theme needs no switch: it follows the host.

dsh-loupe README · Why auto-accumulation was removed：In 1.0.x every explanation appended "selection → first 160 characters of the answer" into a fenced block in `context.md`, which was then injected into the system prompt on every request. 1.2.0 removes that logic entirely:

dsh-loupe README · Why auto-accumulation was removed：- **It was a poor copy of data we already had.** `history.jsonl` keeps the full exchange; the accumulated entry was a 160-character summary, often cut mid-sentence, yet it took prompt budget.
- **It fed the model's own wording back to it.** On a follow-up the model read its previous answer and copied it — one of the main causes of "the follow-up repeats the last answer".
- **It crowded out what the user wrote.** Measured on a long-lived `context.md`: auto-accumulation was 99.9% of the file, 60 entries hit the hard cap, and the 2200-character injection budget only fitted the newest 14 — leaving no room for a hand-written glossary.
- **It undermined its own premise.** Rewriting the document after every answer changed the stable prefix every turn, so the host's prompt cache could never hit.

dsh-loupe README · Why auto-accumulation was removed：Upgrading loses nothing: the migration backs up `context.md.bak-<timestamp>` first, then strips only the tagged block; hand-written content stays as it was.
dsh-loupe README · Settings：Change these in the Settings page, under "Params"; the next explanation picks them up.

dsh-loupe README · Settings：| Setting | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| Reasoning level | `off` | `off` / `low` / `high` / `max`. Explaining one passage does not need high reasoning. |
| Neighbouring messages | `0` | `0` / `1` / `2` / `4`. How many messages before and after the selection go into the prompt. 0 = only the message the selection sits in. |
| Glass look | `on` | `on` / `off`. Translucent + background blur; off is a solid background, which drags more smoothly. |
| Context cap | `2200` | `800` / `2200` / `4000` / `8000` characters. How much of `context.md` gets injected. |
| Language | `auto` | `auto` / `zh` / `en`. `auto` uses the host's language preference (`locale.preference`), falling back to the browser language (the host page's `lang` attribute is a static template value and is never used). Only the interface and the prompt are translated. |

dsh-loupe README · Data and routes：<details>
<summary>For anyone editing the code or wiring it up</summary>

Data lands in `~/.dsh/loupe/` (it follows `DSH_HOME` when that is set):

```
context.md     plugin context (only what you wrote)
history.jsonl  every exchange (append-only, never rewritten; above 8MB only the tail is read)
debug.log      selection diagnostics (one JSON line per selection; above 512 KB only the last 200 lines survive)
```

dsh-loupe README · Data and routes：Since 1.2.0 nothing is auto-accumulated. On upgrade the plugin strips the legacy block out of the file and keeps the original as `context.md.bak-<timestamp>`; the result shows up in `contextMigration` on `/probe` and at the top of the Context tab.

`debug.log` records what the host actually received for one selection — the file to read when an explanation claims a word "is not in the conversation" while you can see it on screen:

dsh-loupe README · Data and routes：```json
{"at":1792424435881,"kind":"assistant-step","turn":"51","node":"14:assistant-step51:3",
 "len":2093,"sent":1915,"win":[193,2093],"anchor":921,
 "selAt":[196,300,460],"winAt":[18,122,282],"head80":"…（前面省略 193 字）…"}
```

dsh-loupe README · Data and routes：| Field | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `kind` / `turn` / `node` | type of the message node picked, its turn, its node key |
| `len` / `sent` | characters in that message / characters actually sent (above 1900 the window centres on the selection) |
| `win` | start and end offsets of the window inside the original message |
| `selAt` / `winAt` | where the selection sits in the message / in the sent window; an empty `winAt` means the window missed it |
| `head80` | first 80 characters of the sent window |

dsh-loupe README · Data and routes：Logging is on by default and stays local. To turn it off, run `localStorage.setItem('loupe-debug','0')` in the browser console and refresh; set it back to `'1'` and refresh to re-enable.

Routes provided by the host half:

dsh-loupe README · Data and routes：```
GET  /plugins/dsh-loupe/probe     diagnostics: host capabilities / model resolution / context writability / drag events / workspace probe
POST /plugins/dsh-loupe/explain   the explain call (SSE: meta / thinking / reasoning / first / delta / done / error)
GET  /plugins/dsh-loupe/history   history (newest first; ?limit= &offset= &q= for search and paging)
GET  /plugins/dsh-loupe/context   read the context

dsh-loupe README · Data and routes：The `/explain` request body: `selection` / `question` / `messageText` / `neighborCount` / `reasoningEffort` / `contextChars`; a follow-up adds `history: [{ question, answer }]` (the client takes the last 6 turns of this window, the host trims to 8 turns / 4000 characters per answer / 16000 in total). With `history` present the host assembles the messages as a real multi-turn sequence (`user → assistant → user …`, with the selection only in the first one). Whatever `context.md` holds, any legacy auto-accumulated block is stripped before injection (1.2.0 writes none; on a migrated machine there is nothing to strip).

dsh-loupe README · Data and routes：Code layout:

```
lib/index.js       host half — routes / prompt assembly / stream parsing / disk writes (imports Node built-ins only)
lib/client.js      UI half — selection / bubble / window / four tabs (hand-written module, no build step)
cordis.patch.yml   the patch
docs/              implementation and fix records, including a post-mortem of the "save" path

The host half does not hot-reload (editing `lib/index.js` needs a profile restart); the UI half just needs a refresh.

</details>

dsh-loupe README · Uninstall：```bash
dsh plugin --profile <profile> remove dsh-loupe
```

`~/.dsh/loupe/` is not removed with it. Delete that folder by hand if you want it gone for good.
